assertion_types.recommends: The answer recommends a control whose name contains at least one string from `must_mention_any`. All matching is case-insensitive substring.
assertion_types.must_not_recommend: None of the strings in `strings` is presented as the recommended control. Naming it as the wrong choice is allowed.
assertion_types.must_not_mention: None of the strings in `strings` appear anywhere in the answer or report.
assertion_types.reads_reference: The agent reads at least one of the files in `files` (checked in the tool-call transcript).
assertion_types.max_references_read: The agent reads at most `max` files under `references/`. Catches over-reading that wastes tokens.
assertion_types.report_finding: Review report contains a finding grouped under `topic` whose body mentions at least one string from `must_mention_any` AND at least one from `must_anchor_on`.
assertion_types.report_empty: Review output is the negative response ('No Fiori guideline violations found') with zero findings.
assertion_types.finding_count_max: Total findings under `topic` (or globally if `topic` is omitted) is <= `max`. Catches over-flagging.
